community.intro: To maintain a welcoming and constructive environment, we have established rules that all members must respect during their interactions on +2Télé.

respect.title: Mutual Respect

spam.title: No Spam
spam.description: Repetitive messages, unsolicited advertising, and malicious links are prohibited.

avatar.title: Profile Pictures
avatar.description: Your profile picture must not contain offensive, discriminatory, violent, sexually explicit, or otherwise inappropriate content. Impersonating a staff member or any other person is also forbidden. Non-compliant pictures will be removed and may result in a sanction.
